description: The full writing brief for ONE page: the studio's method, the rules, the examples chosen for that page, and (after page 1) page 1's file to continue. You rarely need it: page 1's brief comes with create_deck and each submit_page reply carries the next page's. Use it for a helper that writes one page with nothing in front of it.

guest_token.description: Only for a deck created WITHOUT an account: the guest_token create_deck returned.

page.description: Which page, 1 first. Page 1 must be saved before any other page's brief.

name: get_page_brief
title: Get one page's brief
